oracle-l5r-10481.note: Bayushi Kachiko: "After the next time this turn a target Personality attacks, his controller loses 2 Honor" needs a ruling (does "attacks" mean he is declared into an attacking army, or that he makes an Attack action?) and a one-shot turn watch keyed to it. Her static -1F term is plain P9 data once the reading is chosen.

oracle-l5r-10486.note: Kokujin: "if Kokujin wins, you may destroy one of your Personalities (at any location) to take control of the loser (he joins Kokujin's army)" is a choice made after the duel resolves, among one option per Personality of yours plus plain destruction. Duel outcomes in this engine apply directly; a deferred outcome decision needs the P1 after-action trait queue extended (EmperorP1.cs) or a new post-duel decision hook.

oracle-l5r-10404.note: Warded Premises: "Negate all Force bonuses from actions to cards at this battlefield" needs the engine to tell an action's Force modifier from a token, an Item, a Permanent modifier ("Permanently give him +2F") and a static term, and a ruling on whether a permanent bonus is negated for good. Its second ability (put this Terrain into play at a battlefield with no Terrain, even without a unit there) is wireable.
